2: Whoever sends via an indolater, vessels whose particular use is for wine, needs to seal them with one seal so that it can be recognized if the idolater put wine in them. And there is an opinion that requires a seal within a seal. "And if they are large barrels, it is permitted to leave them in the house of the skilled idolater for a day or two to fix them, for it is not customary to use such a large vessel for a short time."
